warning.titlePre: Mercedes GLC300d Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your GLC300d is an early X253-generation model with the OM651 diesel — roughly 2015 to 2018 — injector seal leaks and timing chain wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, shared with the C-Class family of that era. We replace injector seals, timing chain components and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.
The later X253 models (from around 2018) and the current X254 generation use a different engine, the OM654, which doesn't share this specific issue — it's a separate, more recent design.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-glc-class.md. OM654 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to early X253 generation
